doc: L1 data residency per SM. data_array_bytes / reserved_bytes: the array (l1_residency v4: 248 KiB usable on both devices). shared_configuration_<i>_bytes (i = 0..9, ascending, absent beyond the device's list): the shared-memory carveout configurations the driver can select; the engine derives the launch's configuration with the occupancy rule (n_res = min(32 CTAs per SM, 64 warps per SM / warps per CTA, largest configuration / (static + dynamic + 1 KiB per CTA)); configuration = smallest listed value >= n_res x per-CTA need, else the largest) and the L1 data budget is data_array - reserved - configuration (protocol-v4 engine_finding; 10 / 10 default-hint cells on both devices).
